question: Which of the following is associated with a glacial landform?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Horns**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Horns is associated with **glacial landforms.
 
• **Glaciers create landforms **by eroding and depositing material.
 
• The movement **of glaciers is driven by gravity**
 
• **Other glacial landforms include: **
 
 
• U-shaped valleys
 
• Fjords
 
• Hanging valleys
 
• Nunataks
 
• Arêtes
 
• Lateral and medial moraines
 
• Terminal and recessional moraines<
